name: The chat orchestrates development
title: The chat orchestrates development
story: You look for the card that builds a feature, here the refund. Without naming a card, a line goes into the main chat: find who builds the refund and tell them how to key it. The project agent reads the board, finds #122, a click sends the line, and it arrives in the running session. The moral: the chat writes no code, it orchestrates development for you.
